subject: Renewal: capacity staging and stakeholder windows
messages:
From: Aisha Malik <aisha.malik@skygrid.ai>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@skygrid.ai>
Date: Sun, 10 May 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal planning & tentative timeline

Hi Sergio —

Thanks for the quick onboarding earlier this year. We’re starting internal planning for our contract renewal (Term ends 2026-07-31) and want to get a lightweight kickoff in place so we don’t scramble in July. High level asks:

- Confirm Redwood’s recommended timeline to lock terms & capacity for our anticipated +50% throughput increase in H2.
- Quick QBR window in late June/first week of July for exec alignment.
- Who at Redwood should own procurement/legal touchpoints?

I attached a first-pass mutual action plan and the brief our finance team will use for procurement. Tom (cc) will be our procurement lead.

Can you propose a two-week timeline with milestone owners? We prefer short synchronous check-ins (30 min) + one QBR.

Appreciate it —
Aisha Malik
Head of Platform, SkyGrid.ai
attachments: SkyGrid_Mutual_Action_Plan_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Malik <aisha.malik@skygrid.ai>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@skygrid.ai>
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal planning & tentative timeline

Hi Aisha (and Tom) —

Thanks for the note and the MAP — this is perfect. Short answer: we can support a +50% committed throughput with a staged uplift and an accelerated SLA review. Proposed next steps below; I’ll coordinate internally and loop in the right folks for procurement/legal evidence.

Proposed 2-week timeline (high level):
1) Week 0 (this week) — Align stakeholders and confirm forecast (Sergio).
2) Week 1 — Capacity sizing and recommended instance/quantization profile (David Kim — cc).
3) Week 1 end — Procurement checklist & draft term changes (Marissa Cole — cc).
4) Week 2 — Internal exec QBR prep + confirm QBR date with your execs.

QBR windows we have open: June 23–25 (early afternoons PT) and July 6–8 (mornings PT). Please pick preferred blocks and we’ll reserve.

Quick asks for your side:
- Final forecast by end of this week (tokens/day + peak QPS).
- Procurement contact (Tom) to confirm billing/legal cadence.
- Any compliance evidence needs beyond SOC2 summary (attached).

I attached a short checklist. I’ll start a shared MAP in Drive and drop the link once created.

Thanks —
Sergio Alvarez
Senior Account Lead, Redwood Inference
attachments: Redwood_Renewal_Checklist_v0.2.pdf (pdf)
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 08:04:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: SkyGrid renewal — owner assignments and timeline

Marissa / David —

Looping you both into the SkyGrid renewal thread. Quick assignment suggestions so we move fast:

- David: run capacity sizing and recommend instance mix + quantization profile. Target: deliver recommendation doc by Fri 5/15 EOD. Consider 8k token contexts and expected 55% concurrency bump.
- Marissa: own procurement/legal check (billing terms, PO cadence, any commercial exceptions). Draft redline of term changes by Mon 5/18.
- Sergio (me): coordinate MAP with customer, set QBR date, and escalate if needed.

I’ll include a short readiness checklist in the shared MAP. If either of you foresee blockers (SLA change requests, HIPAA/reg docs), flag them and I’ll pull in Solutions/Legal.

Related links: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1Xq-example-maup (MAP)

—Sergio
From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@skygrid.ai>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, Aisha Malik <aisha.malik@skygrid.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 13 May 2026 09:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal planning & tentative timeline

Thanks — that looks good to us.

We’ll:
- Finalize forecast (tokens/day + peak) and drop it into the MAP by Thursday 5/14.
- Prefer the June 24 window for QBR (afternoon PT).
- We need two procurement items clarified in the term redline: invoice cadence and data residency clause (we will request EU-only residency for a subset of logs).

Also attaching a short list of procurement contacts and our internal PO template. If you can start the redline with invoice cadence options and a data-residency note, we’ll review quickly.

Tom Reynolds
Procurement Lead, SkyGrid.ai
attachments: SkyGrid_Procurement_Contacts.pdf (pdf), SkyGrid_PO_Template.docx (docx)
